transcript:
MEETING HEADER
Date: 2026-02-15
Time: 16:00-16:45 UTC
Duration: 45 minutes
Attendees: Jenna Ortiz (Redwood AE), Marcus Lee (Redwood SE), Aisha Patel (CISO, HealthCorp), Liam O'Connor (Head of IT), Maya Singh (Compliance Manager)

Summary: Quick posture review of Redwood's SOC 2 / ISO artifacts, trust center access, controls mapping. Customer concerned with data residency, KMS/HSM, audit logs retention, RBAC/SSO setup and private deployment options.

Topics: SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 cert, Trust Center, controls mapping, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logs, KMS, data residency, Private/VPC deployment.

Transcript:
[00:00] Jenna Ortiz: Alright everyone thanks for joining. we'll do a quick posture review of our SOC 2 and ISO artifacts — I have Marcus from security and compliance with me, hi Marcus.
[00:05] Marcus Lee: hey all, morning / afternoon depending where you are, i'll run through controls and what we can share today.
[00:10] Aisha Patel: thanks. Our goal is to validate you meet our SOC 2 controls and to map to our ISO 27001 requirements. we also need to understand trust center access and how audit logs are stored and for how long.
[00:20] Liam O'Connor: and data residency — we have PHI in some workloads, so we need clarity on encryption in transit and at rest, plus KMS options and whether keys can be customer-managed.
[00:30] Marcus Lee: good questions. high level — we offer hosted API, dedicated reserved capacity, and private VPC/on-prem. for SOC 2 and ISO we have Type II reports and an ISO 27001 certificate; we'll share the reports via the trust center link.
[00:40] Maya Singh: is the trust center a self-serve portal or do you push artifacts to us?
[00:45] Jenna Ortiz: typically we upload to a secure trust center; customers get link-based access with RBAC. Marcus will outline access levels.
[00:55] Marcus Lee: right. access is role-based — read-only for compliance reviewers, restricted for production deploys. SSO via SAML/Okta is supported; we also do SCIM provisioning for user sync. there can be confusion with our different team names — sorry transcription might show some typos.
[01:10] Aisha Patel: can we get the SOC 2 mapping to our internal control IDs? that's key for our auditors.
[01:15] Marcus Lee: yes, we can provide a controls mapping spreadsheet that maps SOC 2/ISO controls to Redwood controls and evidence artifacts. we'll redact any customer-specific data.
[01:25] Liam O'Connor: about KMS — can we bring our own keys/HSM? we need customer-managed keys for some PHI workloads.
[01:30] Marcus Lee: for Private deployments yes you can integrate with your KMS/HSM; for Dedicated we support customer-managed keys through our key management integrations (KMS) — for hosted customers we provide encryption at rest with managed keys but can discuss BYOK options for enterprise plans.
[01:45] Aisha Patel: audit logs — retention and access? our policy requires 7 years for certain events.
[01:50] Marcus Lee: default retention is 1 year for detailed logs and longer for aggregated metrics; but with enterprise add-on we can extend retention and export logs to customer S3 or SIEM. we'll document the retention SLAs in the trust center.
[02:05] Maya Singh: what about RBAC granularity? we need least privilege for operators vs engineers.
[02:10] Marcus Lee: RBAC supports role-level permissions and can be integrated with your SSO. we also provide token-level audit trails, per-route model usage, and tracing hooks in the console.
[02:25] Liam O'Connor: data residency — do you have region guarantees? our data must stay in EU for patient data.
[02:30] Jenna Ortiz: yes we have regional deployments; we can pin workloads to EU-only infrastructure for Private or Dedicated deployments. Hosted may have regional controls depending on the region, but we'll surface the exact regions in the trust center docs.
[02:45] Aisha Patel: what's the process to get access to the trust center? we need to share it with our external auditors.
[02:50] Marcus Lee: we'll send a support link. typically Jenna will add the requester emails and set read-only links. we can also provide signed artefacts: SOC 2 Type II PDF and ISO cert.
[03:05] Maya Singh: any penalties or caveats about redaction? we need proof of controls but also can't expose other customers.
[03:10] Marcus Lee: we redact inter-customer data. evidence is provided as control-level artifacts that don't include PII. where necessary we provide screenshots or logs with masked values.
[03:25] Aisha Patel: do you have external pen test reports or internal vulnerability management evidence?
[03:30] Marcus Lee: yes, we do annual pen tests and a vulnerability management program; the summary is in trust center, and detailed reports can be shared under NDA.
[03:45] Liam O'Connor: networking — for Private: do we manage VPC peering and routing? any constraints on IP ranges?
[03:50] Marcus Lee: for Private deployments you manage your VPC and we provide an appliance or endpoint; we publish the required egress/ingress ports and recommended CIDR ranges.
[04:05] Aisha Patel: timeline — we're targeting vendor onboarding by end of Q1. what do you need from us to start a pilot?
[04:10] Jenna Ortiz: typically we need a scope: expected throughput, models to test, compliance requirements. Marcus will prepare a controls mapping and we can set up trust center access once paperwork is signed.
[04:25] Marcus Lee: i'll also prepare a short checklist for security to start a pilot: NDA, MSA addendum for data processing, list of reviewers, and contact for SSO setup.
[04:40] Jenna Ortiz: ok let's recap next steps. Marcus will share the controls mapping and trust center invite, I'll send SOC 2/ISO artifacts, Aisha will confirm auditor emails and any special evidence requests.
[04:50] Aisha Patel: sounds good. please include the data residency region guarantees in writing and the KMS BYOK options.
[04:55] Jenna Ortiz: noted. any final questions?
[05:00] Maya Singh: no, that's it. thanks.
[05:02] Jenna Ortiz: thanks everyone, we'll follow up with those items and schedule a technical deep-dive next week.

AUTO-GEN ACTION ITEMS:
- Jenna to upload SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 cert to trust center
- Marcus to prepare controls mapping spreadsheet

END OF TRANSCRIPT
